latest.title: Teen drinking falls, alcohol ambulance call-outs don't
latest.finding: A small but significant monthly decline occurred only among males in major cities (B = −0.01, P < .001); no significant trends for males in regional areas or for females in metropolitan or regional areas

latest.title: Resuscitative thoracotomy: no survivors past 10 minutes
latest.finding: 43.1% achieved ROSC and 6.9% survived to discharge; outcomes were substantially better with cardiac tamponade than exsanguination, and there were no survivors beyond 10 minutes of traumatic cardiac arrest

latest.title: Ultrasound tube confirmation: thin evidence on the road
latest.finding: Only one of 51 included studies evaluated diagnostic performance in adult patients in an out-of-hospital setting; no included study measured patient-oriented outcomes

latest.title: Machine learning predicts good recovery after OHCA
latest.finding: The voting-classifier model predicted 6-month neurologically intact survival (29.3% of patients) with AUROC 0.929 and AUPRC 0.850; the top five predictors were prehospital initial rhythm, arrival rhythm, age, PaCO2 and total collapse duration
